```{r date-setup}
shp <- merge(ev$shapes[xpath %in% xp$xpath], sm, by = "xpath")
fmt <- shp[, .(n = sum(n_filings)), by = .(series, shape)]
fmt[, share := n / sum(n), by = series]
fmt[, format := fcase(shape == "9999-99-99", "date (YYYY-MM-DD)",
                      grepl("^9999-99-99A99:99:99", shape), "timestamp",
                      shape == "9999", "year (YYYY)",
                      default = "other")]

rng <- st[, .(min_value = min(min_value, na.rm = TRUE), max_value = max(max_value, na.rm = TRUE),
              n = sum(n_filings), p_date = wmean(p_date, n_occurrences)), by = .(tax_year, series)]
rng[, `:=`(min_year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(substr(min_value, 1, 4))),
           max_year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(substr(max_value, 1, 4))))]

checks <- list()
add <- function(check, result, detail) checks[[length(checks) + 1]] <<- data.frame(check = check, result = result, detail = detail)
main_fmt <- fmt[, .(n = sum(n)), by = format][order(-n)]
share_main <- if (nrow(main_fmt)) main_fmt$n[1] / sum(main_fmt$n) else NA
add("One date format", if (is.na(share_main)) "info" else if (share_main >= 0.99) "pass" else "warn",
    if (is.na(share_main)) "no values" else sprintf("%.1f%% use %s", 100 * share_main, main_fmt$format[1]))
# Earliest/latest values are single extremes, so these are informational:
# a mapping problem shows up in the format and parse checks instead.
future <- rng[!is.na(max_year) & max_year > tax_year + 3]
add("Dates after the tax year", if (!nrow(future)) "pass" else "info",
    if (!nrow(future)) "latest date is within 3 years of the tax year in every year"
    else sprintf("%d of %d tax years contain a date more than 3 years later (e.g. TY%d: %s)",
                 nrow(future), nrow(rng), future$tax_year[1], future$max_value[1]))
old <- rng[!is.na(min_year) & min_year < 1900]
add("Dates before 1900", if (!nrow(old)) "pass" else "info",
    if (!nrow(old)) "no dates before 1900"
    else sprintf("%d of %d tax years contain a date before 1900 (e.g. %s)", nrow(old), nrow(rng), old$min_value[1]))
check_table(do.call(rbind, checks))
```

```{r date-plot, fig.height = 3.2}
if (nrow(rng)) {
  p <- ggplot(rng, aes(tax_year, p_date, colour = series)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    scale_series("colour") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2009, 2024, 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = "Share of values that parse as a calendar date", subtitle = "Years (YYYY) and timestamps do not parse as dates; see the format table",
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_report()
  print(p)
}
html_table(fmt[order(series, -n), .(Series = series, Shape = shape, Format = format, Filings = n, Share = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * share))],
           caption = "Formats (value shapes: 9 = digit, A = letter)")
html_table(rng[order(series, tax_year), .(Series = series, `Tax year` = tax_year, Filings = n, Earliest = min_value, Latest = max_value)],
           caption = "Earliest and latest value by tax year", collapse = TRUE)
checklist <- c(
  "The format is consistent (date, year or timestamp) and matches the data type.",
  "The date is on the expected side of the tax period (e.g. signature date after the period ends, formation year before it).",
  "Extreme earliest/latest values are data-entry errors, not a mapping problem."
)
```
